_note: Mail App's admin area: the menu down the side and its pages (Mailboxes, Routing, Backups, Reports). Edit the wording here.
title: Admin

mailboxes.intro: Manage personal and shared team mailboxes across all your configured domains.

statusHelp.checkDomain: Some of {domain}'s mail records need attention. See Domains.
statusHelp.locked: Someone else's mailbox. Opening it is logged where they can see it.

domains.intro: Domains set up to receive email in Mail App, alongside the current health of their DNS and mail records.

routing.intro: All incoming email addresses and aliases, and the mailboxes they deliver to.

kindHelp.alias: Also delivers to this mailbox. Its user can send from it too.
kindHelp.catchAll: Gets email sent to any address at this domain that isn't listed here.

routing.removeBody: Email sent to {address} won't arrive any more, unless the domain has a catch-all.
routing.catchAllIntro: Choose a mailbox to receive messages sent to unlisted addresses on your domains, catching mistyped names and old contacts.
routing.catchAllOff: Off: unknown addresses are turned away

form.title: New address
form.help: Create an alias for a mailbox, such as sales@ or hello@. The mailbox owner can receive and send messages from this address.

routing.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

backups.intro: Mail App automatically backs up every mailbox nightly to your own Cloudflare R2 storage. We recommend downloading local archives periodically to keep an independent offline copy.
backups.startedAll: Backing up {count} mailboxes. This page updates as each one finishes.
backups.locked: To download or restore someone else's mailbox, open it from Mailboxes first. That's logged where they can see it.
backups.lockedShort: Open it from Mailboxes to download

summary.all: Every mailbox has an up-to-date backup from the last 24 hours.
summary.some: {count} mailboxes have no backup from the last day.
summary.one: 1 mailbox has no backup from the last day.

reports.intro: Monitor your Mail App activity at a glance: inbound and outbound message volumes, spam detection rates, storage utilisation and security audit logs showing mailbox access.
reports.failed: The report couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
reports.unreadable: Couldn't read {mailboxes} just now, so they're left out.
reports.estimated: Continuous metric tracking commenced on {date}. Figures prior to this date are reconstructed from existing mailbox contents, so historical totals may be marginally understated.
reports.failuresIntro: The latest few, so you can spot a mistyped address or a blocked contact.

spamWhy.checks: Failed our scam and junk checks
spamWhy.rule: Sent to Spam by an inbox rule

reports.spamWhyNote: Only spam caught since counting started shows a reason.
reports.notSpam: "Not spam" pressed {count} times, so those senders now go to the inbox.
reports.notSpamOne: "Not spam" pressed once, so that sender now goes to the inbox.
reports.topSenders: Senders with the most mail in Spam
reports.storageFreeNote: Inside the storage Cloudflare includes. Other apps on your Cloudflare account share it.
reports.storageDollarsNote: Cloudflare charges $0.015 per GB a month over 10 GB for files, and $0.20 per GB a month over 5 GB for email text.
reports.storageNote: Email text also holds calendars, contacts and notes. Attachments, Files and backups are in your Cloudflare storage (R2).
reports.logIntro: Every time an admin opened someone else's mailbox, and when access was given or taken away. Each mailbox's users can see their own entries in Settings.
reports.logNone: Nobody opened anyone else's mailbox in this period.

find.label: Find an email
find.placeholder: Find an email by address, domain or subject
find.failed: The search couldn't be run. Please try again.
find.title: Emails matching "{q}"
find.intro: Every mailbox, over the last {days} days. Open an email to read it. Opening someone else's mailbox is logged where they can see it.
find.more: Showing the latest {count}. Narrow the search to see older ones.
find.none: Nothing found in the last {days} days.
find.noneHelp: If someone says they sent an email and it isn't here, it was turned away before it arrived. Check the address they used is on Routing, and that the domain's mail records are right on Domains.
find.noProblems: No problems: everything found was delivered or sent.
find.spamWhyUnknown: Sent to Spam by an inbox rule, or before reasons were kept.
find.openLockedHelp: Someone else's mailbox. Opening it is logged where they can see it.
